::: {.key-facts}
At the 2022 census, 277,737 people lived in County Galway, up 7.6% on 2016. It had the third largest population of the 26 counties.

Its population in 2022 was 63% of its population in 1841, the last census before the Great Famine.

In 2025, the average monthly rent on a new tenancy in County Galway was €1,637, the 4th highest of the 26 counties.
:::
